overall_notes: The paper focuses on reducing named entity hallucinations in abstractive text summarization. The extracted metadata was generally accurate with minor issues around metric normalization. The paper conducts both automatic evaluation (ROUGE, NEHR) and human evaluation of entity faithfulness. No LLMs were used as judges despite mentioning them in the literature review.
